#   full-DAG, Linux-only: grafana/ci, grafana/frontend-metrics, cli/lint
#   selected-leg (Linux-only jobs): deno/linux, pydantic/linux, valkey/linux
set -Eeuo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
WORKSPACE_ROOT="${CONFORMANCE_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-/tmp/preloop-conformance-5repos/workspaces}"
ENGINE="${ENGINE:-pool}"
OUTPUT_ROOT="${CONFORMANCE_OUTPUT_ROOT:-$ROOT/benchmarks/real-world/results/main-conformance-5repos/$ENGINE}"
CAMPAIGN_HOME="${CONFORMANCE_HOME:-/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/5repos-home}"
PORT="${CONFORMANCE_PORT:-9197}"
POLL_SECONDS="${CONFORMANCE_POLL_SECONDS:-10}"
TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-10800}"
POOL_SIZE="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_POOL_SIZE:-1}"
SMOLVM_PROCESS_HOME="${CONFORMANCE_SMOLVM_HOME:-$CAMPAIGN_HOME/smolvm-home}"
export PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN="${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN:-preloop-system-token}"
export PRELOOP_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${PRELOOP_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-900}"

SERVER_BIN="${PRELOOP_BIN:-$ROOT/target/release/preloop}"
CLIENT_BIN="${PRELOOP_CLIENT_BIN:-$ROOT/target/release/preloop-runner-client}"
GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_BUNDLE:-$ROOT/target/release}"

# Official ubuntu24 amd64 hosted-image snapshot (runner-large), digest-pinned
# to the project's vetted pin (versions.toml official_runner_image_base_amd64).
OFFICIAL_GOLDEN_BASE="ghcr.io/preloopdev/runner-images:ubuntu24-runner-large-latest@sha256:4f7e4be438e4eb9c0f23bebdec12cf1d25520876ad2052412ba18580919b7795"
OFFICIAL_GOLDEN_NAME="preloop-ghcr.REDACTED"

# Runner labels the pool and both external engines advertise, so any job the
# five workflows can schedule on a Linux pool is claimable by all three.
RUNNER_LABELS="X64,ubuntu-arm64-small,ubuntu-x64-small,ubuntu-x64,ubuntu-x64-large"

SERVER_PID=""
FAILED_TARGETS=""

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: main-conformance-5repos.sh [all|grafana|deno|pydantic|valkey|cli]

Environment:
  ENGINE                   pool (default) | official | agentenv
  CONFORMANCE_WORKSPACE_ROOT   clone root
  CONFORMANCE_OUTPUT_ROOT      result root
  CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS  per-workflow timeout (default 10800)
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_POOL_SIZE     concurrent fork slots (default 1)
  CONFORMANCE_TARGETS          space-separated target IDs (overrides positional repo)
EOF
}

fail() {
  echo "main-conformance-5repos: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

# target_cfg returns: repo-slug git-url branch workflow event git-ref [selected_jobs]
target_cfg() {
  case "$1" in
    grafana/ci)
      echo "grafana https://github.com/grafana/grafana.git main .github/workflows/backend-unit-tests.yml push refs/heads/main" ;;
    grafana/frontend-metrics)
      echo "grafana https://github.com/grafana/grafana.git main .github/workflows/frontend-lint.yml push refs/heads/main" ;;
    deno/linux)
      # Linux-only jobs of deno's generated CI (bench + deno_core tests; lint
      # and every other matrix has macos/windows legs).
      echo "deno https://github.com/denoland/deno.git main .github/workflows/ci.generated.yml push refs/heads/main|bench,deno-core-test" ;;
    pydantic/linux)
      echo "pydantic https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic.git main .github/workflows/ci.yml push refs/heads/main|lint,core-bench,core-test-msrv,core-test-debug,docs-build,test-memray,test-plugin,test-mypy" ;;
    valkey/linux)
      echo "valkey https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey.git unstable .github/workflows/ci.yml push refs/heads/unstable|test-ubuntu-latest,test-ubuntu-latest-compatibility,test-ubuntu-latest-cmake-tls,test-sanitizer-address,test-rdma,test-tls-only,build-debian-old,build-32bit,build-libc-malloc,build-almalinux8-jemalloc,format-yaml" ;;
    cli/lint)
      echo "cli https://github.com/cli/cli.git trunk .github/workflows/lint.yml push refs/heads/trunk" ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

all_targets() {
  echo "grafana/ci grafana/frontend-metrics deno/linux pydantic/linux valkey/linux cli/lint"
}

repo_targets() {
  case "$1" in
    grafana) echo "grafana/ci grafana/frontend-metrics" ;;
    deno) echo "deno/linux" ;;
    pydantic) echo "pydantic/linux" ;;
    valkey) echo "valkey/linux" ;;
    cli) echo "cli/lint" ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

clone_repo() {
  local slug="$1" url="$2" branch="$3" dir="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/$1"
  mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE_ROOT"
  if [ ! -d "$dir/.git" ]; then
    echo "=== cloning $slug ($branch) ==="
    git clone "$url" "$dir"
  else
    echo "=== refreshing $slug ($branch) ==="
    git -C "$dir" remote set-url origin "$url"
    git -C "$dir" fetch --prune --tags origin
  fi
  git -C "$dir" fetch --prune --tags origin "$branch"
  git -C "$dir" checkout -B "$branch" "origin/$branch"
  git -C "$dir" reset --hard "origin/$branch"
  git -C "$dir" clean -fdx
}

start_server() {
  local log="$OUTPUT_ROOT/server.log"
  mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_ROOT" "$CAMPAIGN_HOME" "$SMOLVM_PROCESS_HOME"
  rm -f "$log"
  if [ "$ENGINE" = pool ]; then
    POOL_ENABLED=1
  else
    POOL_ENABLED=0
  fi
  PRELOOP_HOME="$CAMPAIGN_HOME" \
  HOME="$SMOLVM_PROCESS_HOME" \
  SMOLVM_DATA_DIR="${SMOLVM_DATA_DIR:-$CAMPAIGN_HOME/smolvm}" \
  SMOLVM_AGENT_ROOTFS="${SMOLVM_AGENT_ROOTFS:-/opt/smolvm/agent-rootfs}" \
  SMOLVM_LIB_DIR="${SMOLVM_LIB_DIR:-/opt/smolvm/lib}" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_BASE_IMAGE="$OFFICIAL_GOLDEN_BASE" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_BUNDLE="$GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_NAME_PREFIX="bench5repos" \
  PRELOOP_USE_PACKED_GOLDEN=1 \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_POOL_ENABLED="$POOL_ENABLED" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_POOL_SIZE="$POOL_SIZE" \
  PRELOOP_USE_FORK=1 \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_MEMORY_MIB="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_MEMORY_MIB:-8192}" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_STORAGE_GB="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_STORAGE_GB:-160}" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_LABELS="$RUNNER_LABELS" \
  PRELOOP_CONTROL_UPSTREAM="http://10.0.0.161:$PORT" \
  PRELOOP_PUBLIC_URL="http://10.0.0.161:$PORT" \
  RUST_LOG="${RUST_LOG:-info,preloop=debug}" \
  "$SERVER_BIN" serve --listen "0.0.0.0:$PORT" >"$log" 2>&1 &
  SERVER_PID=$!
  for _ in $(seq 1 180); do
    if curl -fsS --max-time 5 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/healthz" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "=== [$ENGINE] preloop server ready on :$PORT ==="
      return 0
    fi
    if ! kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
      tail -50 "$log" >&2 || true
      fail "preloop server exited during startup"
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  tail -100 "$log" >&2 || true
  fail "preloop server did not become ready"
}

cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$SERVER_PID" ] && kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'cleanup; exit 130' INT
trap 'cleanup; exit 143' TERM

run_status() {
  curl -fsS --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN}" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/runs/$1" 2>/dev/null \
    | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(r.get("status", "unknown"))' \
    || echo unknown
}

run_snapshot() {
  local run_id="$1" output="$2"
  curl -fsS --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN}" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/runs/$run_id" >"$output" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' '{}' >"$output"
}

write_push_payload() {
  local workspace="$1" branch="$2" output="$3"
  python3 - "$workspace" "$branch" >"$output" <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess
import sys

workspace, branch = sys.argv[1:]

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", workspace, *args], text=True
    ).splitlines()

head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")[0]
try:
    before = git("rev-parse", "HEAD^")[0]
except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
    before = "0" * 40
paths = git("ls-files")

print(json.dumps({
    "before": before,
    "after": head,
    "ref": f"refs/heads/{branch}",
    "paths": paths,
    "commits": [{"modified": paths, "added": [], "removed": []}],
    "repository": {"default_branch": branch},
    "pull_request": {
        "number": 1,
        "base": {"ref": branch, "sha": before},
        "head": {"ref": branch, "sha": head},
    },
}, separators=(",", ":")))
PY
}

wait_run() {
  local target="$1" run_id="$2" deadline status
  deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + TIMEOUT_SECONDS ))
  while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" ]; do
    if ! kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "[$target] preloop server exited; cannot poll run $run_id" >&2
      printf '%s\n' server-crashed
      return 0
    fi
    status="$(run_status "$run_id")"
    case "$status" in
      success|failure|cancelled|skipped) printf '%s\n' "$status"; return 0 ;;
    esac
    sleep "$POLL_SECONDS"
  done
  printf '%s\n' timeout
}

run_target() {
  local target="$1"
  local cfg slug url branch workflow event git_ref selected
  cfg="$(target_cfg "$target")" || fail "unknown target: $target"
  IFS='|' read -r base selected <<<"$cfg"
  read -r slug url branch workflow event git_ref <<<"$base"
  clone_repo "$slug" "$url" "$branch"
  local ws_dir="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/$slug"
  [ -f "$ws_dir/$workflow" ] || fail "$target workflow is missing after checkout: $ws_dir/$workflow"
  local target_dir="$OUTPUT_ROOT/$target"
  rm -rf "$target_dir"
  mkdir -p "$target_dir"
  write_push_payload "$ws_dir" "$branch" "$target_dir/event.json"
  echo "=== [$ENGINE/$target] submitting $workflow ($event $git_ref) ==="
  local submit_args=(--server "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" submit
    -W "$ws_dir/$workflow" --workspace-root "$ws_dir"
    --repository "$slug" --git-ref "$git_ref" --event "$event" --payload "$target_dir/event.json")
  if [ -n "${selected:-}" ]; then
    submit_args+=(--selected-jobs "$selected")
    echo "    selected jobs: $selected"
  fi
  local submit
  if ! submit="$("$CLIENT_BIN" "${submit_args[@]}" 2>&1)"; then
    printf '%s\n' "$submit" | tee "$target_dir/submit.txt"
    fail "[$target] workflow submission failed"
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$submit" | tee "$target_dir/submit.txt"
  local run_id
  run_id="$(printf '%s\n' "$submit" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["run_id"])')"
  printf '%s\n' "$run_id" >"$target_dir/run-id.txt"
  local t0 t1 final_status
  t0="$(date +%s%3N)"
  final_status="$(wait_run "$target" "$run_id")"
  t1="$(date +%s%3N)"
  run_snapshot "$run_id" "$target_dir/run.json"
  printf '%s\n' "$final_status" >"$target_dir/status.txt"
  echo "=== [$ENGINE/$target] final status: $final_status (wall: $((t1-t0))ms) ==="
  # Timing record: driver wall clock + server-observed timestamps.
  python3 - "$target_dir" "$run_id" "$final_status" "$((t1-t0))" "$ENGINE" "$selected" <<'PY' || true
import json, sys, pathlib
d, run_id, status, wall_ms, engine, selected = sys.argv[1:]
p = pathlib.Path(d) / "timing.json"
r = json.loads((pathlib.Path(d) / "run.json").read_text())
jobs = r.get("jobs", {})
print(json.dumps({
    "engine": engine, "run_id": run_id, "status": status,
    "wall_ms": int(wall_ms), "selected": selected or None,
    "created_at": r.get("created_at"), "started_at": r.get("started_at"),
    "completed_at": r.get("completed_at"),
    "run_status": r.get("status"),
    "job_statuses": {k: v for k, v in jobs.items() if isinstance(v, str)},
}, indent=2))
json.dump({
    "engine": engine, "run_id": run_id, "status": status,
    "wall_ms": int(wall_ms), "selected": selected or None,
    "created_at": r.get("created_at"), "started_at": r.get("started_at"),
    "completed_at": r.get("completed_at"),
    "run_status": r.get("status"),
    "job_statuses": {k: v for k, v in jobs.items() if isinstance(v, str)},
}, open(p, "w"), indent=2)
PY
  case "$final_status" in
    success|skipped) ;;
    *) FAILED_TARGETS="${FAILED_TARGETS}${target}=${final_status}\n" ;;
  esac
}

main() {
  local repo="${1:-all}"
  local target_list
  if [ -n "${CONFORMANCE_TARGETS:-}" ]; then
    target_list="$CONFORMANCE_TARGETS"
  elif [ "$repo" = "all" ]; then
    target_list="$(all_targets)"
  else
    target_list="$(repo_targets "$repo")" || fail "unknown repository: $repo"
  fi
  [ -x "$SERVER_BIN" ] || fail "missing server binary: $SERVER_BIN"
  [ -x "$CLIENT_BIN" ] || fail "missing client binary: $CLIENT_BIN"
  [ -x "$GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE/preloop-runner" ] || fail "missing guest runner: $GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE/preloop-runner"
  start_server
  for target in $target_list; do
    run_target "$target"
  done
  if [ -n "$FAILED_TARGETS" ]; then
    printf 'Campaign failures:\n%b' "$FAILED_TARGETS" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  echo "Campaign complete. Results: $OUTPUT_ROOT"
}

main "$@"

  SMOLVM_AGENT_ROOTFS="${SMOLVM_AGENT_ROOTFS:-/opt/smolvm/agent-rootfs}" \
  SMOLVM_LIB_DIR="${SMOLVM_LIB_DIR:-/opt/smolvm/lib}" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_BASE_IMAGE="$OFFICIAL_GOLDEN_BASE" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_BUNDLE="$GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_NAME_PREFIX="bench5repos" \
  PRELOOP_USE_PACKED_GOLDEN=1 \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_POOL_ENABLED="$POOL_ENABLED" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_POOL_SIZE="$POOL_SIZE" \
  PRELOOP_USE_FORK=1 \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_MEMORY_MIB="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_MEMORY_MIB:-8192}" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_STORAGE_GB="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_STORAGE_GB:-160}" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_LABELS="$RUNNER_LABELS" \
  PRELOOP_CONTROL_UPSTREAM="http://10.0.0.161:$PORT" \
  PRELOOP_PUBLIC_URL="http://10.0.0.161:$PORT" \
  RUST_LOG="${RUST_LOG:-info,preloop=debug}" \
  "$SERVER_BIN" serve --listen "0.0.0.0:$PORT" >"$log" 2>&1 &
  SERVER_PID=$!
  for _ in $(seq 1 180); do
    if curl -fsS --max-time 5 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/healthz" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "=== [$ENGINE] preloop server ready on :$PORT ==="
      return 0
    fi
    if ! kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
      tail -50 "$log" >&2 || true
      fail "preloop server exited during startup"
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  tail -100 "$log" >&2 || true
  fail "preloop server did not become ready"
}

cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$SERVER_PID" ] && kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'cleanup; exit 130' INT
trap 'cleanup; exit 143' TERM

run_status() {
  curl -fsS --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN}" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/runs/$1" 2>/dev/null \
    | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(r.get("status", "unknown"))' \
    || echo unknown
}

run_snapshot() {
  local run_id="$1" output="$2"
  curl -fsS --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN}" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/runs/$run_id" >"$output" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' '{}' >"$output"
}

write_push_payload() {
  local workspace="$1" branch="$2" output="$3"
  python3 - "$workspace" "$branch" >"$output" <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess
import sys

workspace, branch = sys.argv[1:]

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", workspace, *args], text=True
    ).splitlines()

head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")[0]
try:
    before = git("rev-parse", "HEAD^")[0]
except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
    before = "0" * 40
paths = git("ls-files")

print(json.dumps({
    "before": before,
    "after": head,
    "ref": f"refs/heads/{branch}",
    "paths": paths,
    "commits": [{"modified": paths, "added": [], "removed": []}],
    "repository": {"default_branch": branch},
    "pull_request": {
        "number": 1,
        "base": {"ref": branch, "sha": before},
        "head": {"ref": branch, "sha": head},
    },
}, separators=(",", ":")))
PY
}

wait_run() {
  local target="$1" run_id="$2" deadline status
  deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + TIMEOUT_SECONDS ))
  while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" ]; do
    if ! kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "[$target] preloop server exited; cannot poll run $run_id" >&2
      printf '%s\n' server-crashed
      return 0
    fi
    status="$(run_status "$run_id")"
    case "$status" in
      success|failure|cancelled|skipped) printf '%s\n' "$status"; return 0 ;;
    esac
    sleep "$POLL_SECONDS"
  done
  printf '%s\n' timeout
}

run_target() {
  local target="$1"
  local cfg slug url branch workflow event git_ref selected
  cfg="$(target_cfg "$target")" || fail "unknown target: $target"
  IFS='|' read -r base selected <<<"$cfg"
  read -r slug url branch workflow event git_ref <<<"$base"
  clone_repo "$slug" "$url" "$branch"
  local ws_dir="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/$slug"
  [ -f "$ws_dir/$workflow" ] || fail "$target workflow is missing after checkout: $ws_dir/$workflow"
  local target_dir="$OUTPUT_ROOT/$target"
  rm -rf "$target_dir"
  mkdir -p "$target_dir"
  write_push_payload "$ws_dir" "$branch" "$target_dir/event.json"
  echo "=== [$ENGINE/$target] submitting $workflow ($event $git_ref) ==="
  local submit_args=(--server "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" submit
    -W "$ws_dir/$workflow" --workspace-root "$ws_dir"
    --repository "$slug" --git-ref "$git_ref" --event "$event" --payload "$target_dir/event.json")
  if [ -n "${selected:-}" ]; then
    submit_args+=(--selected-jobs "$selected")
    echo "    selected jobs: $selected"
  fi
  local submit
  if ! submit="$("$CLIENT_BIN" "${submit_args[@]}" 2>&1)"; then
    printf '%s\n' "$submit" | tee "$target_dir/submit.txt"
    fail "[$target] workflow submission failed"
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$submit" | tee "$target_dir/submit.txt"
  local run_id
  run_id="$(printf '%s\n' "$submit" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["run_id"])')"
  printf '%s\n' "$run_id" >"$target_dir/run-id.txt"
  local t0 t1 final_status
  t0="$(date +%s%3N)"
  final_status="$(wait_run "$target" "$run_id")"
  t1="$(date +%s%3N)"
  run_snapshot "$run_id" "$target_dir/run.json"
  printf '%s\n' "$final_status" >"$target_dir/status.txt"
  echo "=== [$ENGINE/$target] final status: $final_status (wall: $((t1-t0))ms) ==="
  # Timing record: driver wall clock + server-observed timestamps.
  python3 - "$target_dir" "$run_id" "$final_status" "$((t1-t0))" "$ENGINE" "$selected" <<'PY' || true
import json, sys, pathlib
d, run_id, status, wall_ms, engine, selected = sys.argv[1:]
p = pathlib.Path(d) / "timing.json"
r = json.loads((pathlib.Path(d) / "run.json").read_text())
jobs = r.get("jobs", {})
print(json.dumps({
    "engine": engine, "run_id": run_id, "status": status,
    "wall_ms": int(wall_ms), "selected": selected or None,
    "created_at": r.get("created_at"), "started_at": r.get("started_at"),
    "completed_at": r.get("completed_at"),
    "run_status": r.get("status"),
    "job_statuses": {k: v for k, v in jobs.items() if isinstance(v, str)},
}, indent=2))
json.dump({
    "engine": engine, "run_id": run_id, "status": status,
    "wall_ms": int(wall_ms), "selected": selected or None,
    "created_at": r.get("created_at"), "started_at": r.get("started_at"),
    "completed_at": r.get("completed_at"),
    "run_status": r.get("status"),
    "job_statuses": {k: v for k, v in jobs.items() if isinstance(v, str)},
}, open(p, "w"), indent=2)
PY
  case "$final_status" in
    success|skipped) ;;
    *) FAILED_TARGETS="${FAILED_TARGETS}${target}=${final_status}\n" ;;
  esac
}

main() {
  local repo="${1:-all}"
  local target_list
  if [ -n "${CONFORMANCE_TARGETS:-}" ]; then
    target_list="$CONFORMANCE_TARGETS"
  elif [ "$repo" = "all" ]; then
    target_list="$(all_targets)"
  else
    target_list="$(repo_targets "$repo")" || fail "unknown repository: $repo"
  fi
  [ -x "$SERVER_BIN" ] || fail "missing server binary: $SERVER_BIN"
  [ -x "$CLIENT_BIN" ] || fail "missing client binary: $CLIENT_BIN"
  [ -x "$GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE/preloop-runner" ] || fail "missing guest runner: $GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE/preloop-runner"
  start_server
  for target in $target_list; do
    run_target "$target"
  done
  if [ -n "$FAILED_TARGETS" ]; then
    printf 'Campaign failures:\n%b' "$FAILED_TARGETS" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  echo "Campaign complete. Results: $OUTPUT_ROOT"
}

main "$@"
"}

runner_setup() {
  # Inside the VM: create the runner user, fetch the official runner if the
  # image lacks it, and print the directory that contains config.sh/run.sh.
  cat <<'SETUP'
set -e
if id -u runner >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; else useradd -m -s /bin/bash runner; fi
for d in /opt/runners/actions-runner /opt/actions-runner /home/runner/actions-runner; do
  if [ -f "$d/config.sh" ]; then echo "FOUND:$d"; exit 0; fi
done
cd /tmp
curl -fsSL -o runner.tar.gz https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v2.336.0/actions-runner-linux-x64-2.336.0.tar.gz
mkdir -p /opt/actions-runner && tar xzf runner.tar.gz -C /opt/actions-runner
chown -R runner:runner /opt/actions-runner /tmp/runner.tar.gz
echo "FOUND:/opt/actions-runner"
SETUP
}

start_engine() {
  echo "=== engine=official: creating smolvm machine $MACHINE ==="
  "$SMOLVM" machine create --name "$MACHINE" --net --image "$IMAGE" 2>>"$LOG" \
    || "$SMOLVM" machine create --name "$MACHINE" --net 2>>"$LOG"
  "$SMOLVM" machine start --name "$MACHINE" >>"$LOG" 2>&1
  # Wait for the guest to answer exec.
  for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
    if "$SMOLVM" machine exec --name "$MACHINE" -- true >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
    sleep 2
  done
  echo "=== engine=official: setting up runner inside VM ==="
  local runner_dir
  runner_dir="$("$SMOLVM" machine exec --name "$MACHINE" -- bash -s <<'SETUP'
set -e
if id -u runner >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; else useradd -m -s /bin/bash runner; fi
for d in /opt/runners/actions-runner /opt/actions-runner /home/runner/actions-runner; do
  if [ -f "$d/config.sh" ]; then echo "FOUND:$d"; exit 0; fi

curl -fsSL -o runner.tar.gz https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v2.336.0/actions-runner-linux-x64-2.336.0.tar.gz
mkdir -p /opt/actions-runner && tar xzf runner.tar.gz -C /opt/actions-runner
chown -R runner:runner /opt/actions-runner
echo "FOUND:/opt/actions-runner"
SETUP
)"
  runner_dir="${runner_dir##*FOUND:}"
  echo "runner dir: $runner_dir"
  local token
  token="$(curl -fsS -X POST \
    -H "Authorization: RemoteAuth $PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v3/repos/preloopdev/preloop/actions/runners/registration-token" \
    | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["token"])')"
  echo "registration token acquired"
  # Configure (persistent, not ephemeral) and run in the background inside the VM.
  "$SMOLVM" machine exec --name "$MACHINE" -- bash -s "$runner_dir" "$token" "$SERVER_URL" "$LABELS" <<'CONF' >>"$LOG" 2>&1 &

        "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/runners" 2>/dev/null \
        | grep -q '"name": "[^"]*off-runner[^"]*"'; then
      echo "=== engine=official: runner registered ==="
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  echo "engine=official: runner did not register within 180s; check $LOG" >&2
  return 1
}

stop_engine() {
  "$SMOLVM" machine stop --name "$MACHINE" 2>/dev/null || true
  "$SMOLVM" machine delete --name "$MACHINE" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "=== engine=official: stopped and deleted $MACHINE ==="
}

case "${1:-start}" in
  start) start_engine ;;
  stop) stop_engine ;;
  *) echo "usage: $0 start|stop" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# main-engine-agentenv.sh — provision the preloop Rust runner inside one
# AgentENV (Firecracker) sandbox for ENGINE=agentenv runs. Persistent
# listener: claims every job of the phase, then exits on stop.
#
# Usage: main-engine-agentenv.sh start|stop
set -Eeuo pipefail

PORT="${CONFORMANCE_PORT:-9197}"
SERVER_URL="http://10.0.0.161:$PORT"
export PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN="${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN:-preloop-system-token}"
AENV=/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/AgentENV/target/release/aenv
IMAGE="ghcr.io/preloopdev/runner-images:ubuntu24-runner-large-latest@sha256:4f7e4be438e4eb9c0f23bebdec12cf1d25520876ad2052412ba18580919b7795"
LABELS="self-hosted,linux,x64,X64,ubuntu-arm64-small,ubuntu-x64-small,ubuntu-x64,ubuntu-x64-large"
PRELOOP_RUNNER=/home/bnjoroge/preloop/target/release/preloop-runner
LOG=/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/5repos-engine-agentenv.log
SID_FILE=/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/5repos-agentenv-sid

start_engine() {
  echo "=== engine=agentenv: starting sandbox (cold, 6 cpu, 8 GiB) ==="
  local out sid
  out="$("$AENV" start --cold "$IMAGE" --cpu 6 --memory 8192 --disk-size-mb 163840 --timeout 14400 -d 2>&1)"
  sid="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -oE '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}' | tail -1)"
  [ -n "$sid" ] || { echo "no sandbox id from: $out" >&2; return 1; }
  echo "$sid" >"$SID_FILE"
  echo "sandbox $sid"
  # Wait for the sandbox to answer exec.
  for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
    if "$AENV" exec "$sid" sh -c "true" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
    sleep 2
  done
  echo "=== engine=agentenv: uploading preloop-runner ==="
  "$AENV" upload "$sid" "$PRELOOP_RUNNER" /usr/local/bin/preloop-runner
  "$AENV" exec "$sid" chmod +x /usr/local/bin/preloop-runner
  echo "=== engine=agentenv: configuring runner in sandbox ==="
  "$AENV" exec "$sid" env \
    PRELOOP_RUNNER_TOKEN="$PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN" \
    /usr/local/bin/preloop-runner configure \
      --url "$SERVER_URL" \
      --name "agentenv-runner" \
      --labels "$LABELS" \
      --runner-root /var/lib/preloop-runner \
      --unattended --replace \
      --no-externals >>"$LOG" 2>&1
  echo "=== engine=agentenv: starting runner listener ==="
  "$AENV" exec "$sid" env \
    PRELOOP_RUNNER_TOKEN="$PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN" \
    RUST_LOG=info \
    nohup /usr/local/bin/preloop-runner --runner-root /var/lib/preloop-runner run \
      >/var/lib/preloop-runner/runner.log 2>&1 &
  # Wait for registration.
  for _ in $(seq 1 90); do

# main-engine-agentenv.sh — provision the preloop Rust runner inside one
# AgentENV (Firecracker) sandbox for ENGINE=agentenv runs. Persistent
# listener: claims every job of the phase, then exits on stop.
#
# Usage: main-engine-agentenv.sh start|stop
set -Eeuo pipefail

SERVER_URL="http://10.0.0.161:$PORT"
export PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN="${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN:-preloop-system-token}"
AENV=/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/AgentENV/target/release/aenv

LABELS="self-hosted,linux,x64,X64,ubuntu-arm64-small,ubuntu-x64-small,ubuntu-x64,ubuntu-x64-large"
PRELOOP_RUNNER=/home/bnjoroge/preloop/target/release/preloop-runner
LOG=/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/5repos-engine-agentenv.log
SID_FILE=/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/5repos-agentenv-sid

start_engine() {
  echo "=== engine=agentenv: starting sandbox (cold, 6 cpu, 8 GiB) ==="
  local out sid
  out="$("$AENV" start --cold "$IMAGE" --cpu 6 --memory 8192 --disk-size-mb 163840 --timeout 14400 -d 2>&1)"
  sid="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -oE '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}' | tail -1)"
  [ -n "$sid" ] || { echo "no sandbox id from: $out" >&2; return 1; }
  echo "$sid" >"$SID_FILE"
  echo "sandbox $sid"
  # Wait for the sandbox to answer exec.
  for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
    if "$AENV" exec "$sid" sh -c "true" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
    sleep 2
  done
  echo "=== engine=agentenv: uploading preloop-runner ==="
  "$AENV" upload "$sid" "$PRELOOP_RUNNER" /usr/local/bin/preloop-runner
  "$AENV" exec "$sid" chmod +x /usr/local/bin/preloop-runner
  echo "=== engine=agentenv: configuring runner in sandbox ==="
  "$AENV" exec "$sid" env \
    PRELOOP_RUNNER_TOKEN="$PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN" \

      --url "$SERVER_URL" \
      --name "agentenv-runner" \
      --labels "$LABELS" \
      --runner-root /var/lib/preloop-runner \
      --unattended --replace \
      --no-externals >>"$LOG" 2>&1

  "$AENV" exec "$sid" env \
    PRELOOP_RUNNER_TOKEN="$PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN" \
    RUST_LOG=info \
    nohup /usr/local/bin/preloop-runner --runner-root /var/lib/preloop-runner run \
      >/var/lib/preloop-runner/runner.log 2>&1 &
  # Wait for registration.
  for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
    if curl -fsS -m 5 -H "Authorization: Bearer $PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN" \
        "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/runners" 2>/dev/null \
        | grep -q '"name": "agentenv-runner"'; then
      echo "=== engine=agentenv: runner registered ==="
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  echo "engine=agentenv: runner did not register within 180s; check $LOG" >&2
  return 1
}

stop_engine() {
  local sid
  sid="$(cat "$SID_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -n "$sid" ]; then
    "$AENV" stop "$sid" 2>/dev/null || true
    echo "=== engine=agentenv: stopped sandbox $sid ==="
  fi
}

case "${1:-start}" in
  start) start_engine ;;
  stop) stop_engine ;;
  *) echo "usage: $0 start|stop" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

"""Host-side resource sampler for the three-engine benchmark on main.

Writes CSV rows every SAMPLE_SECONDS: wall clock, loadavg, memory, and
per-process CPU% / RSS for the engines' processes (preloop server, smolvm
_boot-vm, firecracker, aenv, qemu). Run with ENGINE=<name> for the output
file; stop with SIGINT.

import csv
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

OUT = Path(os.environ.get("SAMPLER_OUT", "/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/5repos-sampler.csv"))
ENGINE = os.environ.get("ENGINE", "unknown")
SAMPLE_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("SAMPLER_SECONDS", "5"))
WATCH = ("preloop", "_boot-vm", "smolvm", "firecracker", "aenv", "qemu", "uvm-ublk", "agentenv")

def read_proc_stat():
    out = {}
    for line in Path("/proc/stat").read_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith("cpu "):
            parts = line.split()
            # user nice system idle iowait irq softirq steal
            vals = [int(x) for x in parts[1:]]
            out["total"] = sum(vals)
            out["idle"] = vals[3] + vals[4]
    return out

def read_mem():
    mem = {}
    for line in Path("/proc/meminfo").read_text().splitlines():
        k, _, v = line.partition(":")
        if k in ("MemTotal", "MemAvailable", "SwapFree"):
            mem[k] = int(v.strip().split()[0])
    return mem

def main():
    f = open(OUT, "w", newline="")
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["ts", "engine", "load1", "load5", "load15",
                "mem_total_kb", "mem_avail_kb", "swap_free_kb",
                "proc", "pid", "cpu_pct", "rss_kb", "cmd"])
    prev = read_proc_stat()
    last = time.time()
    try:
        while True:
            time.sleep(SAMPLE_SECONDS)
            now = time.time()
            cur = read_proc_stat()
            dt = now - last
            total_d = max(cur["total"] - prev["total"], 1)
            idle_d = max(cur["idle"] - prev["idle"], 0)
            host_cpu = (1 - idle_d / total_d) * 100
            prev = cur
            last = now
            load = tuple(Path("/proc/loadavg").read_text().split()[:3])
            mem = read_mem()
            procs = []
            for line in Path("/proc").glob("[0-9]*"):
                try:
                    cmd = (line / "cmdline").read_bytes().decode(errors="replace").replace("\0", " ").strip()
                    if not cmd:
                        cmd = "[" + (line / "comm").read_text().strip() + "]"
                except OSError:
                    continue
                if not any(w in cmd for w in WATCH):
                    continue
                try:
                    stat = (line / "stat").read_text()
                    parts = stat.split()
                    rss = int(parts[23]) * os.sysconf("SC_PAGE_SIZE") // 1024
                    # utime+stime in clock ticks
                    ticks = (int(parts[13]) + int(parts[14]))
                except (OSError, IndexError, ValueError):
                    continue
                procs.append((line.name, cmd, ticks, rss))
            # deltas per process
            if procs:
                try:
                    sf = f_prev
                except NameError:
                    sf = {}
            else:
                sf = {}
            for pid, cmd, ticks, rss in procs:
                p_prev = sf.get(pid, (ticks, rss, time.time()))
                p_cpu = (ticks - p_prev[0]) * 100.0 / max(total_d, 1)
                w.writerow([f"{now:.3f}", ENGINE, load[0], load[1], load[2],
                            mem["MemTotal"], mem["MemAvailable"], mem["SwapFree"],
                            cmd.split()[0] if cmd else "", pid, f"{p_cpu:.1f}", rss, cmd[:120]])
            f.flush()
            sf = {p: (t, r, time.time()) for p, c, t, r in procs}
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        f.close()
    print(f"sampler done: {OUT}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

name: release-golden

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Release tag to receive the generated assets (defaults to latest)
        required: false
        type: string
      reuse_previous_goldens:
        description: Copy existing goldens instead of rebuilding them
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
      previous_release_tag:
        description: Release tag whose goldens should be reused
        required: false
        default: v0.29.5
        type: string

jobs:
  reuse-previous-goldens:
    name: Reuse Previous Golden Artifacts
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.reuse_previous_goldens
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Copy goldens to target release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          TARGET_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
          PREVIOUS_TAG: ${{ inputs.previous_release_tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "$TARGET_TAG" ]; then
            TARGET_TAG="$(gh release view --json tagName --jq .tagName)"
          fi
          mkdir -p dist
          gh release download "$PREVIOUS_TAG" \
            --pattern 'preloop-ubuntu-24.04-*' \
            --dir dist \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          # Preserve the signatures, attestations, and base-evidence sidecars
          # when a release intentionally reuses an earlier golden.
          gh release upload "$TARGET_TAG" \
            dist/preloop-ubuntu-24.04-* \
            --clobber \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"

  build-and-publish-linux-binaries:
    name: Build Linux ${{ matrix.arch }} release
    if: github.event_name == 'release'
    # Cross-compilation needs no KVM. Keep the scarce self-hosted executor
    # available for the golden VM build and the repository's normal CI.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: x86_64
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
          - arch: aarch64
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain

        with:
          # Pin the workspace toolchain: the action's `stable` default does

The official runner image unpacked is ~60-120GB. The agent VM's extraction of the image layers into /storage/layers filled the 20GB disk → extraction failed on the dotnet dll (ENOSPC swallowed into "failed to unpack").

Wait — but the machine spec has storage_gb from PRELOOP_RUNNER_STORAGE_GB=160... The MachineSpec: let me see the create path — the smolvm provider (in lib.rs — the provider is implemented IN lib.rs? The storage template is used when the spec doesn't request more? The runner machines get 160GB — how? The spec's storage_gb → smolvm machine create with a bigger disk (resize the template). Hmm — but the AGENT VM (the golden bake VM) spec at lib.rs:5332: MachineSpec { name: golden, image: config.base_image, cpus: config.cpus, ... } — does it include storage_gb? The elided fields — need to see. If the bake agent VM uses the DEFAULT storage (20GB template), that's the bug: the official image needs >20GB.

Actually wait — hold on. Let me reconsider how smolvm image machines work: the image (OCI) layers are the READ-ONLY base; the writable overlay is the storage template (20GB). The pull extracts layers into /storage/layers (writable). So the VM needs disk ≥ sum(unpacked layers) + overlay. Official image unpacked: probably 60-100GB (the packed .smolmachine is 9GB compressed). So 20GB writable → ENOSPC. CONFIRMED root cause (very likely).

The fix: bigger storage for the bake agent VM. Where does the agent VM's storage come from? Check lib.rs 5320-5360 (the golden bake spec) + the MachineSpec storage_gb → provider.create → smolvm machine create. The evidence: the extraction failed → it used ~20GB → the spec likely doesn't set storage for the bake agent VM, OR smolvm machine create doesn't accept a storage-size flag and the 160GB applies differently.

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect whether code changed
    # Run on `grafana/grafana` main branch, or on pull requests to prevent double-running on mirrors
    if: (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || (github.event_name == 'push' && github.repository == 'grafana/grafana'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-arm64-small
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      changed: ${{ steps.detect-changes.outputs.backend }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: true # required to get more history in the changed-files action
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none
      - name: Detect changes
        id: detect-changes
        uses: ./.github/actions/change-detection
        with:
          self: .github/workflows/backend-unit-tests.yml

  grafana:
    # Run this workflow only for PRs from forks
    # the `pr-backend-unit-tests-enterprise` workflow will run instead
    needs: detect-changes
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork == true && needs.detect-changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        shard: [
          1/8, 2/8, 3/8, 4/8,
          5/8, 6/8, 7/8, 8/8,
        ]
      fail-fast: false

    name: Grafana (${{ matrix.shard }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-x64
    continue-on-error: true
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
      - name: Run unit tests
        env:
          SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          readarray -t PACKAGES <<< "$(./scripts/ci/backend-tests/shard.sh -N"$SHARD")"
          CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -vet=off -short -timeout=30m "${PACKAGES[@]}"

  grafana-enterprise:
    # Run this workflow for non-PR events (like pushes to `main` or `release-*`) OR for internal PRs (PRs not from forks)
    needs: detect-changes
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork == false && needs.detect-changes.outputs.changed == 'true')
    strategy:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Assemble the 5-repo 3-engine benchmark report from the results tree.

Reads:
  benchmarks/real-world/results/main-conformance-5repos/<engine>/<target>/timing.json
  .../<engine>/server.log
  /var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/5repos-sampler-<engine>.csv
Writes a markdown report to the results root.
"""
import csv
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path("/home/bnjoroge/preloop/benchmarks/real-world/results/main-conformance-5repos")
SAMPLER_DIR = pathlib.Path("/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks")
ENGINES = ["pool", "official", "agentenv"]
TARGET_ORDER = ["grafana/ci", "grafana/frontend-metrics", "deno/linux", "pydantic/linux", "valkey/linux", "cli/lint"]

def load_timing(engine, target):
    p = ROOT / engine / target / "timing.json"
    if not p.exists():
        return None
    try:
        return json.loads(p.read_text())
    except Exception:
        return None

def load_sampler(engine):
    p = SAMPLER_DIR / f"5repos-sampler-{engine}.csv"
    if not p.exists():
        return None
    rows = []
    try:
        with open(p) as f:
            for r in csv.DictReader(f):
                rows.append(r)
    except Exception:
        return None
    return rows

def main():
    lines = []
    lines.append("# Preloop 5-Repo Conformance + 3-Engine Benchmark")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("Host: `main` (Linux x86_64, KVM, 6 cores, 22 GiB RAM). Repo 657e61b7; official ubuntu24-runner-large amd64 golden (digest 4f7e4be4).")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Per-engine run summary (driver wall clock)")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("| Target | pool (A) | official (B) | agentenv (C) |")
    lines.append("|---|---|---|---|")
    for t in TARGET_ORDER:
        cells = []
        for e in ENGINES:
            tm = load_timing(e, t)
            if tm is None:
                cells.append("—")
            else:
                cells.append(f"{tm.get('status','?')} ({tm.get('wall_ms',0)/1000:.0f}s)")
        lines.append(f"| {t} | " + " | ".join(cells) + " |")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Per-engine details")
    lines.append("")
    for e in ENGINES:
        lines.append(f"### Engine {e}")
        lines.append("")
        for t in TARGET_ORDER:
            tm = load_timing(e, t)
            if tm is None:
                continue
            lines.append(f"**{t}** — status {tm.get('status')}, wall {tm.get('wall_ms',0)/1000:.0f}s")
            lines.append(f"- server: created={tm.get('created_at')} completed={tm.get('completed_at')} run_status={tm.get('run_status')} selected={tm.get('selected')}")
            jobs = tm.get("job_statuses") or {}
            if jobs:
                from collections import Counter
                c = Counter(v for v in jobs.values() if isinstance(v, str))
                lines.append(f"- jobs: {len(jobs)} — " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in c.items()))
                lines.append("")
        s = load_sampler(e)
        if s:
            try:
                ts = [float(r["ts"]) for r in s]
                span = max(ts) - min(ts) if len(ts) > 1 else 0
                lines.append(f"Host sampler: {len(s)} samples over {span/60:.0f} min")
                lines.append("")
            except Exception:
                pass
    out = ROOT / "REPORT.md"
    out.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    print(out)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/agentenv/bin/busybox sh
# AgentENV tools drive init (PID 1).
# Boot on /dev/vda (tools drive), pivot_root to /dev/vdb (user image),
# then hand off to the post-pivot bootstrap at /agentenv/pivot-init.
#
# No "set -e" here. PID 1 should fail into a shell instead of exiting and
# panicking the guest on recoverable bootstrap errors.

BB=/agentenv/bin/busybox
die() { echo "INIT FATAL: $*" >&2; exec $BB sh; }

# Minimal virtual filesystems needed before pivot_root.
$BB mount -n -t proc proc /proc || die "mount proc"
$BB mount -n -t sysfs sysfs /sys || die "mount sysfs"
if $BB mount -n -t cgroup2 cgroup2 /sys/fs/cgroup 2>/dev/null; then
    for c in cpu cpuset memory io pids; do
        echo "+$c" > /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control 2>/dev/null
    done
fi

# Default writable user image.
$BB mount -n -o rw /dev/vdb /mnt/user || die "mount /dev/vdb"

# Minimal user images may not ship the directories that become mount targets
# after pivot_root. Create them on the mounted user rootfs before switching.
$BB mkdir -p \
    /mnt/user/proc \
    /mnt/user/dev \
    /mnt/user/sys \
    /mnt/user/run \
    /mnt/user/tmp \
    /mnt/user/var/run \
    /mnt/user/var/log/agentenv \
    /mnt/user/agentenv
$BB chmod 1777 /mnt/user/tmp 2>/dev/null || true

# Re-expose bundled tools in the pivoted filesystem.
$BB mount -n --bind /agentenv /mnt/user/agentenv || die "bind-mount tools"

# Extra drives requested by AgentENV:
#   agentenv_drives=vdc:/mnt/main,vdd:/mnt/data:sub/path
# Each entry is vd<letter>:<mountPath>[:<subPath>]. mountPath and subPath are
# guaranteed not to contain ':' by API validation, so ':' is an unambiguous
# separator. When subPath is set, only that sub-directory of the drive is
# exposed at <mountPath> (Kubernetes subPath style).
for arg in $($BB cat /proc/cmdline); do
    case "$arg" in
        agentenv_drives=*)
            IFS=','
            for entry in ${arg#agentenv_drives=}; do
                DEV="${entry%%:*}"
                REST="${entry#*:}"
                MNT="${REST%%:*}"
                case "$REST" in
                    *:*) SUB="${REST#*:}" ;;
                    *)   SUB="" ;;
                esac
                $BB mkdir -p "/mnt/user$MNT"
                if [ -n "$SUB" ]; then

    # User images may ship /etc/resolv.conf as a symlink into a distro-specific
    # runtime directory. Replace it with a concrete file derived from the
    # kernel-provided ip=... boot argument so arbitrary images get working DNS.
    if [ -L /etc/resolv.conf ] || [ -e /etc/resolv.conf ]; then
        $BB rm -f /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || true
    fi

    $BB mv "$TMP_RESOLV" /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null \
        || $BB cp "$TMP_RESOLV" /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null \
        || echo "AGENTENV PIVOT INIT WARN: failed to write /etc/resolv.conf" >&2
}

# ---- Bootstrap virtual filesystems a distro init would normally mount ----
# Must happen before `generate_resolv_conf` (writes to /run) and before envd
# starts. Every step fails open (2>/dev/null) because we want the guest to
# boot even if one of these tweaks is refused by the kernel config, and the
# missing piece will surface as a targeted runtime error instead of a PID 1
# abort.

# devpts for pty allocation. Without /dev/pts + /dev/ptmx wired up anything
# that wants a PTY (ssh, tmux, e2b connect, python pty/pexpect) fails with
# `open /dev/ptmx: no such file or directory`.
$BB mkdir -p /dev/pts
$BB mount -n -t devpts -o gid=5,mode=620,ptmxmode=0666 devpts /dev/pts 2>/dev/null
[ -e /dev/ptmx ] || $BB ln -sf pts/ptmx /dev/ptmx

# POSIX shared memory. Chromium, Python multiprocessing, PostgreSQL and
# anything calling shm_open(3) need this.
$BB mkdir -p /dev/shm
$BB mount -n -t tmpfs -o mode=1777,nosuid,nodev tmpfs /dev/shm 2>/dev/null

# /run as tmpfs — PID/socket files belong on an ephemeral fs rather than
# being persisted onto the user image's rootfs through pause/resume cycles.
$BB mkdir -p /run
$BB mount -n -t tmpfs -o mode=0755,nosuid,nodev tmpfs /run 2>/dev/null
$BB mkdir -p /run/lock

# stdio device symlinks. devtmpfs creates these on most kernels, but a
# minimal kernel config or a stripped user image may not have them.
[ -e /dev/fd ]     || $BB ln -sf /proc/self/fd    /dev/fd
[ -e /dev/stdin ]  || $BB ln -sf /proc/self/fd/0  /dev/stdin
[ -e /dev/stdout ] || $BB ln -sf /proc/self/fd/1  /dev/stdout
[ -e /dev/stderr ] || $BB ln -sf /proc/self/fd/2  /dev/stderr

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# main-engine-agentenv.sh — provision the preloop Rust runner inside one
# AgentENV (Firecracker) sandbox for ENGINE=agentenv runs. Persistent
# listener: claims every job of the phase, then exits on stop.
#
# Substrate note: AgentENV cold-starts the official runner-large image but its
# envd exec channel never becomes ready for that image (empty guest serial),
# so this engine uses the plain ubuntu:24.04 base with an apt baseline; the
# workflows' setup-* actions supply per-job toolchains.
#
# Usage: main-engine-agentenv.sh start|stop
set -Eeuo pipefail

PORT="${CONFORMANCE_PORT:-9197}"
SERVER_URL="http://10.0.0.161:$PORT"
export PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN="${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN:-preloop-system-token}"
AENV=/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/AgentENV/target/release/aenv
IMAGE="mirror.gcr.io/library/ubuntu:24.04"
LABELS="self-hosted,linux,x64,X64,ubuntu-arm64-small,ubuntu-x64-small,ubuntu-x64,ubuntu-x64-large"
PRELOOP_RUNNER=/home/bnjoroge/preloop/target/release/preloop-runner
LOG=/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/5repos-engine-agentenv.log
SID_FILE=/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/5repos-agentenv-sid

start_engine() {
  echo "=== engine=agentenv: starting sandbox (cold, 6 cpu, 8 GiB) ==="
  local out sid
  out="$("$AENV" start --cold "$IMAGE" --cpu 6 --memory 8192 --disk-size-mb 65536 --timeout 14400 -d 2>&1)"
  sid="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -oE '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}' | tail -1)"
  [ -n "$sid" ] || { echo "no sandbox id from: $out" >&2; return 1; }
  echo "$sid" >"$SID_FILE"
  echo "sandbox $sid"
  # Wait for the sandbox to answer exec.
  for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
    if "$AENV" exec "$sid" bash -c "true" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
    sleep 2
  done
  echo "=== engine=agentenv: installing baseline toolchain ==="
  "$AENV" exec "$sid" bash -c "apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git curl ca-certificates make gcc g++ python3 jq >/dev/null 2>&1" || true
  echo "=== engine=agentenv: uploading preloop-runner ==="
  "$AENV" upload "$sid" "$PRELOOP_RUNNER" /usr/local/bin/preloop-runner
  "$AENV" exec "$sid" chmod +x /usr/local/bin/preloop-runner
  echo "=== engine=agentenv: configuring runner in sandbox ==="
  "$AENV" exec "$sid" env \
    PRELOOP_RUNNER_TOKEN="$PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN" \
    /usr/local/bin/preloop-runner configure \
      --url "$SERVER_URL" \
      --name "agentenv-runner" \
      --labels "$LABELS" \

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# main-conformance-5repos.sh — five-repository conformance + three-engine
# benchmark driver for the production host (Linux x86_64, KVM).
#
# Engines:
#   ENGINE=pool      preloop Rust runner inside the smolvm pool (official golden)
#   ENGINE=official  official actions/runner v2.336.0 inside one smolvm VM
#   ENGINE=agentenv  preloop Rust runner inside one AgentENV (Firecracker) sandbox
#
# Usage:
#   ENGINE=pool      benchmarks/real-world/main-conformance-5repos.sh [all|grafana|deno|pydantic|valkey|cli]
#   ENGINE=official  benchmarks/real-world/main-conformance-5repos.sh all
#   ENGINE=agentenv  benchmarks/real-world/main-conformance-5repos.sh all
#
# The server runs once per invocation on :9197 against the official
# ubuntu24-runner-large (amd64) golden. Engine != pool disables the pool so
# the externally provisioned runner claims every job.
#
# Targets:
#   full-DAG, Linux-only: grafana/ci, grafana/frontend-metrics, cli/lint
#   selected-leg (Linux-only jobs): deno/linux, pydantic/linux, valkey/linux
set -Eeuo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
WORKSPACE_ROOT="${CONFORMANCE_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-/tmp/preloop-conformance-5repos/workspaces}"
ENGINE="${ENGINE:-pool}"
OUTPUT_ROOT="${CONFORMANCE_OUTPUT_ROOT:-$ROOT/benchmarks/real-world/results/main-conformance-5repos/$ENGINE}"
CAMPAIGN_HOME="${CONFORMANCE_HOME:-/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/5repos-home}"
PORT="${CONFORMANCE_PORT:-9197}"
POLL_SECONDS="${CONFORMANCE_POLL_SECONDS:-10}"
TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-10800}"
POOL_SIZE="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_POOL_SIZE:-1}"
SMOLVM_PROCESS_HOME="${CONFORMANCE_SMOLVM_HOME:-$CAMPAIGN_HOME/smolvm-home}"
export PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN="${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN:-main-5repos-bench-20260819}"
export PRELOOP_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${PRELOOP_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-900}"

SERVER_BIN="${PRELOOP_BIN:-$ROOT/target/release/preloop}"
CLIENT_BIN="${PRELOOP_CLIENT_BIN:-$ROOT/target/release/preloop-runner-client}"
GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_BUNDLE:-$ROOT/target/release}"

# Official ubuntu24 amd64 hosted-image snapshot (runner-large), digest-pinned
# to the project's vetted pin (versions.toml official_runner_image_base_amd64).
OFFICIAL_GOLDEN_BASE="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_BASE_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/preloopdev/runner-images:ubuntu24-runner-large-latest@sha256:4f7e4be438e4eb9c0f23bebdec12cf1d25520876ad2052412ba18580919b7795}"
OFFICIAL_GOLDEN_NAME="preloop-ghcr.REDACTED"

# Runner labels the pool and both external engines advertise, so any job the
# five workflows can schedule on a Linux pool is claimable by all three.
RUNNER_LABELS="X64,ubuntu-arm64-small,ubuntu-x64-small,ubuntu-x64,ubuntu-x64-large"

SERVER_PID=""
FAILED_TARGETS=""

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: main-conformance-5repos.sh [all|grafana|deno|pydantic|valkey|cli]

Environment:
  ENGINE                   pool (default) | official | agentenv
  CONFORMANCE_WORKSPACE_ROOT   clone root
  CONFORMANCE_OUTPUT_ROOT      result root
  CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS  per-workflow timeout (default 10800)
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_POOL_SIZE     concurrent fork slots (default 1)
  CONFORMANCE_TARGETS          space-separated target IDs (overrides positional repo)
EOF
}

fail() {
  echo "main-conformance-5repos: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

# target_cfg returns: repo-slug git-url branch workflow event git-ref [selected_jobs]
target_cfg() {
  case "$1" in
    grafana/ci)
      echo "grafana https://github.com/grafana/grafana.git main .github/workflows/backend-unit-tests.yml push refs/heads/main" ;;
    grafana/frontend-metrics)
      echo "grafana https://github.com/grafana/grafana.git main .github/workflows/frontend-lint.yml push refs/heads/main" ;;
    deno/linux)
      # Linux-only jobs of deno's generated CI (bench + deno_core tests; lint
      # and every other matrix has macos/windows legs).
      echo "deno https://github.com/denoland/deno.git main .github/workflows/ci.generated.yml push refs/heads/main|bench,deno-core-test" ;;
    pydantic/linux)
      echo "pydantic https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic.git main .github/workflows/ci.yml push refs/heads/main|lint,core-bench,core-test-msrv,core-test-debug,docs-build,test-memray,test-plugin,test-mypy" ;;
    valkey/linux)
      echo "valkey https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey.git unstable .github/workflows/ci.yml push refs/heads/unstable|test-ubuntu-latest,test-ubuntu-latest-compatibility,test-ubuntu-latest-cmake-tls,test-sanitizer-address,test-rdma,test-tls-only,build-debian-old,build-32bit,build-libc-malloc,build-almalinux8-jemalloc,format-yaml" ;;
    cli/lint)
      echo "cli https://github.com/cli/cli.git trunk .github/workflows/lint.yml push refs/heads/trunk" ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

all_targets() {
  echo "grafana/ci grafana/frontend-metrics deno/linux pydantic/linux valkey/linux cli/lint"
}

repo_targets() {
  case "$1" in
    grafana) echo "grafana/ci grafana/frontend-metrics" ;;
    deno) echo "deno/linux" ;;
    pydantic) echo "pydantic/linux" ;;
    valkey) echo "valkey/linux" ;;
    cli) echo "cli/lint" ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

clone_repo() {
  local slug="$1" url="$2" branch="$3" dir="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/$1"
  mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE_ROOT"
  if [ ! -d "$dir/.git" ]; then
    echo "=== cloning $slug ($branch) ==="
    git clone "$url" "$dir"
  else
    echo "=== refreshing $slug ($branch) ==="
    git -C "$dir" remote set-url origin "$url"
    git -C "$dir" fetch --prune --tags origin
  fi
  git -C "$dir" fetch --prune --tags origin "$branch"
  git -C "$dir" checkout -B "$branch" "origin/$branch"
  git -C "$dir" reset --hard "origin/$branch"
  git -C "$dir" clean -fdx
}

start_server() {
  local log="$OUTPUT_ROOT/server.log"
  mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_ROOT" "$CAMPAIGN_HOME" "$SMOLVM_PROCESS_HOME"
  rm -f "$log"
  if [ "$ENGINE" = pool ]; then
    POOL_ENABLED=1
  else
    POOL_ENABLED=0
  fi
  PRELOOP_HOME="$CAMPAIGN_HOME" \
  HOME="$SMOLVM_PROCESS_HOME" \
  SMOLVM_DATA_DIR="${SMOLVM_DATA_DIR:-$CAMPAIGN_HOME/smolvm}" \
  SMOLVM_AGENT_ROOTFS="${SMOLVM_AGENT_ROOTFS:-/opt/smolvm/agent-rootfs}" \
  SMOLVM_LIB_DIR="${SMOLVM_LIB_DIR:-/opt/smolvm/lib}" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_BASE_IMAGE="$OFFICIAL_GOLDEN_BASE" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_BUNDLE="$GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_NAME_PREFIX="bench5repos" \
  PRELOOP_USE_PACKED_GOLDEN="${PRELOOP_USE_PACKED_GOLDEN:-1}" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_POOL_ENABLED="$POOL_ENABLED" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_POOL_SIZE="$POOL_SIZE" \
  PRELOOP_USE_FORK=1 \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_MEMORY_MIB="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_MEMORY_MIB:-8192}" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_STORAGE_GB="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_STORAGE_GB:-160}" \
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_LABELS="$RUNNER_LABELS" \
  PRELOOP_CONTROL_ORIGIN="http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" \
  PRELOOP_CONTROL_UPSTREAM="http://10.0.0.161:$PORT" \
  PRELOOP_PUBLIC_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" \
  RUST_LOG="${RUST_LOG:-info,preloop=debug}" \
  "$SERVER_BIN" serve --listen "0.0.0.0:$PORT" >"$log" 2>&1 &
  SERVER_PID=$!
  for _ in $(seq 1 180); do
    if curl -fsS --max-time 5 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/healthz" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "=== [$ENGINE] preloop server ready on :$PORT ==="
      return 0
    fi
    if ! kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
      tail -50 "$log" >&2 || true
      fail "preloop server exited during startup"
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  tail -100 "$log" >&2 || true
  fail "preloop server did not become ready"
}

cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$SERVER_PID" ] && kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'cleanup; exit 130' INT
trap 'cleanup; exit 143' TERM

run_status() {
  curl -fsS --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN}" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/runs/$1" 2>/dev/null \
    | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(r.get("status", "unknown"))' \
    || echo unknown
}

run_snapshot() {
  local run_id="$1" output="$2"
  curl -fsS --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN}" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/runs/$run_id" >"$output" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' '{}' >"$output"
}

write_push_payload() {
  local workspace="$1" branch="$2" output="$3"
  python3 - "$workspace" "$branch" >"$output" <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess
import sys

workspace, branch = sys.argv[1:]

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", workspace, *args], text=True
    ).splitlines()

head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")[0]
try:
    before = git("rev-parse", "HEAD^")[0]
except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
    before = "0" * 40
paths = git("ls-files")

print(json.dumps({
    "before": before,
    "after": head,
    "ref": f"refs/heads/{branch}",
    "paths": paths,
    "commits": [{"modified": paths, "added": [], "removed": []}],
    "repository": {"default_branch": branch},
    "pull_request": {
        "number": 1,
        "base": {"ref": branch, "sha": before},
        "head": {"ref": branch, "sha": head},
    },
}, separators=(",", ":")))
PY
}

wait_run() {
  local target="$1" run_id="$2" deadline status
  deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + TIMEOUT_SECONDS ))
  while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" ]; do
    if ! kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "[$target] preloop server exited; cannot poll run $run_id" >&2
      printf '%s\n' server-crashed
      return 0
    fi
    status="$(run_status "$run_id")"
    case "$status" in
      success|failure|cancelled|skipped) printf '%s\n' "$status"; return 0 ;;
    esac
    sleep "$POLL_SECONDS"
  done
  printf '%s\n' timeout
}

run_target() {
  local target="$1"
  local cfg slug url branch workflow event git_ref selected
  cfg="$(target_cfg "$target")" || fail "unknown target: $target"
  IFS='|' read -r base selected <<<"$cfg"
  read -r slug url branch workflow event git_ref <<<"$base"
  clone_repo "$slug" "$url" "$branch"
  local ws_dir="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/$slug"
  [ -f "$ws_dir/$workflow" ] || fail "$target workflow is missing after checkout: $ws_dir/$workflow"
  local target_dir="$OUTPUT_ROOT/$target"

  mkdir -p "$target_dir"
  write_push_payload "$ws_dir" "$branch" "$target_dir/event.json"
  echo "=== [$ENGINE/$target] submitting $workflow ($event $git_ref) ==="
  local submit_args=(--server "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" submit
    -W "$ws_dir/$workflow" --workspace-root "$ws_dir"
    --repository "$slug" --git-ref "$git_ref" --event "$event" --payload "$target_dir/event.json")

    submit_args+=(--selected-jobs "$selected")
    echo "    selected jobs: $selected"

    printf '%s\n' "$submit" | tee "$target_dir/submit.txt"

  run_id="$(printf '%s\n' "$submit" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["run_id"])')"

r = json.loads((pathlib.Path(d) / "run.json").read_text())
jobs = r.get("jobs", {})
print(json.dumps({
    "engine": engine, "run_id": run_id, "status": status,
    "wall_ms": int(wall_ms), "selected": selected or None,
    "created_at": r.get("created_at"), "started_at": r.get("started_at"),
    "completed_at": r.get("completed_at"),
    "run_status": r.get("status"),
    "job_statuses": {k: v for k, v in jobs.items() if isinstance(v, str)},
}, indent=2))
json.dump({
    "engine": engine, "run_id": run_id, "status": status,
    "wall_ms": int(wall_ms), "selected": selected or None,
    "created_at": r.get("created_at"), "started_at": r.get("started_at"),
    "completed_at": r.get("completed_at"),
    "run_status": r.get("status"),
    "job_statuses": {k: v for k, v in jobs.items() if isinstance(v, str)},

main() {

    return 1
  fi

}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# main-conformance-5repos.sh — five-repository conformance + three-engine
# benchmark driver for the production host (Linux x86_64, KVM).
#
# Engines:
#   ENGINE=pool      preloop Rust runner inside the smolvm pool (official golden)
#   ENGINE=official  official actions/runner v2.336.0 inside one smolvm VM
#   ENGINE=agentenv  preloop Rust runner inside one AgentENV (Firecracker) sandbox
#
# Usage:
#   ENGINE=pool      benchmarks/real-world/main-conformance-5repos.sh [all|grafana|deno|pydantic|valkey|cli]
#   ENGINE=official  benchmarks/real-world/main-conformance-5repos.sh all
#   ENGINE=agentenv  benchmarks/real-world/main-conformance-5repos.sh all
#
# The server runs once per invocation on :9197 against the official
# ubuntu24-runner-large (amd64) golden. Engine != pool disables the pool so
# the externally provisioned runner claims every job.
#
# Targets:
#   full-DAG, Linux-only: grafana/ci, grafana/frontend-metrics, cli/lint
#   selected-leg (Linux-only jobs): deno/linux, pydantic/linux, valkey/linux
set -Eeuo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
WORKSPACE_ROOT="${CONFORMANCE_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-/tmp/preloop-conformance-5repos/workspaces}"
ENGINE="${ENGINE:-pool}"
OUTPUT_ROOT="${CONFORMANCE_OUTPUT_ROOT:-$ROOT/benchmarks/real-world/results/main-conformance-5repos/$ENGINE}"
CAMPAIGN_HOME="${CONFORMANCE_HOME:-/var/lib/preloop/benchmarks/5repos-home}"
PORT="${CONFORMANCE_PORT:-9197}"
POLL_SECONDS="${CONFORMANCE_POLL_SECONDS:-10}"
TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-10800}"
POOL_SIZE="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_POOL_SIZE:-1}"
SMOLVM_PROCESS_HOME="${CONFORMANCE_SMOLVM_HOME:-$CAMPAIGN_HOME/smolvm-home}"
export PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN="${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN:-main-5repos-bench-20260819}"
export PRELOOP_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${PRELOOP_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-900}"

SERVER_BIN="${PRELOOP_BIN:-$ROOT/target/release/preloop}"
CLIENT_BIN="${PRELOOP_CLIENT_BIN:-$ROOT/target/release/preloop-runner-client}"
GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_BUNDLE:-$ROOT/target/release}"

# Official ubuntu24 amd64 hosted-image snapshot (runner-large), digest-pinned
# to the project's vetted pin (versions.toml official_runner_image_base_amd64).
OFFICIAL_GOLDEN_BASE="${PRELOOP_RUNNER_BASE_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/preloopdev/runner-images:ubuntu24-runner-large-latest@sha256:4f7e4be438e4eb9c0f23bebdec12cf1d25520876ad2052412ba18580919b7795}"
OFFICIAL_GOLDEN_NAME="preloop-ghcr.REDACTED"

# Runner labels the pool and both external engines advertise, so any job the
# five workflows can schedule on a Linux pool is claimable by all three.
RUNNER_LABELS="X64,ubuntu-arm64-small,ubuntu-x64-small,ubuntu-x64,ubuntu-x64-large"

SERVER_PID=""
FAILED_TARGETS=""

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: main-conformance-5repos.sh [all|grafana|deno|pydantic|valkey|cli]

Environment:
  ENGINE                   pool (default) | official | agentenv
  CONFORMANCE_WORKSPACE_ROOT   clone root
  CONFORMANCE_OUTPUT_ROOT      result root
  CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS  per-workflow timeout (default 10800)
  PRELOOP_RUNNER_POOL_SIZE     concurrent fork slots (default 1)
  CONFORMANCE_TARGETS          space-separated target IDs (overrides positional repo)
EOF
}

fail() {
  echo "main-conformance-5repos: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

# target_cfg returns: repo-slug git-url branch workflow event git-ref [selected_jobs]
target_cfg() {
  case "$1" in
    grafana/ci)
      echo "grafana https://github.com/grafana/grafana.git main .github/workflows/backend-unit-tests.yml push refs/heads/main" ;;
    grafana/frontend-metrics)
      echo "grafana https://github.com/grafana/grafana.git main .github/workflows/frontend-lint.yml push refs/heads/main" ;;
    deno/linux)
      # Linux-only jobs of deno's generated CI (bench + deno_core tests; lint
      # and every other matrix has macos/windows legs).
      echo "deno https://github.com/denoland/deno.git main .github/workflows/ci.generated.yml push refs/heads/main|bench,deno-core-test" ;;
    pydantic/linux)
      echo "pydantic https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic.git main .github/workflows/ci.yml push refs/heads/main|lint,core-bench,core-test-msrv,core-test-debug,docs-build,test-memray,test-plugin,test-mypy" ;;

FAILED_TARGETS=""

Environment:

# target_cfg returns: repo-slug git-url branch workflow event git-ref [selected_jobs]

      echo "grafana https://github.com/grafana/grafana.git main .github/workflows/backend-unit-tests.yml push refs/heads/main" ;;
    grafana/frontend-metrics)

      # and every other matrix has macos/windows legs).

clone_repo() {

    echo "=== cloning $slug ($branch) ==="

start_server() {
  local log="$OUTPUT_ROOT/server.log"

trap 'cleanup; exit 130' INT

run_status() {
  curl -fsS --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN}" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/runs/$1" 2>/dev/null \
    | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(r.get("status", "unknown"))' \
    || echo unknown
}

run_snapshot() {
  local run_id="$1" output="$2"
  curl -fsS --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN}" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/runs/$run_id" >"$output" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' '{}' >"$output"
}

write_push_payload() {
  local workspace="$1" branch="$2" output="$3" slug="$4"
  python3 - "$workspace" "$branch" "$slug" >"$output" <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess
import sys

workspace, branch, slug = sys.argv[1:]

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", workspace, *args], text=True
    ).splitlines()

head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")[0]
try:
    before = git("rev-parse", "HEAD^")[0]
except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
    before = "0" * 40
paths = git("ls-files")

print(json.dumps({
    "before": before,
    "after": head,
    "ref": f"refs/heads/{branch}",
    "paths": paths,
    "commits": [{"modified": paths, "added": [], "removed": []}],
    "repository": {"full_name": slug, "default_branch": branch},
    "pull_request": {
        "number": 1,
        "base": {"ref": branch, "sha": before},
        "head": {"ref": branch, "sha": head},
    },
}, separators=(",", ":")))
PY
}

wait_run() {
  local target="$1" run_id="$2" deadline status
  deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + TIMEOUT_SECONDS ))
  while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" ]; do
    if ! kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "[$target] preloop server exited; cannot poll run $run_id" >&2
      printf '%s\n' server-crashed
      return 0
    fi
    status="$(run_status "$run_id")"
    case "$status" in
      success|failure|cancelled|skipped) printf '%s\n' "$status"; return 0 ;;
    esac
    sleep "$POLL_SECONDS"
  done
  printf '%s\n' timeout
}

run_target() {
  local target="$1"
  local cfg slug url branch workflow event git_ref selected
  cfg="$(target_cfg "$target")" || fail "unknown target: $target"
  IFS='|' read -r base selected <<<"$cfg"
  read -r slug url branch workflow event git_ref <<<"$base"
  clone_repo "$slug" "$url" "$branch"
  local ws_dir="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/$slug"
  [ -f "$ws_dir/$workflow" ] || fail "$target workflow is missing after checkout: $ws_dir/$workflow"
  local target_dir="$OUTPUT_ROOT/$target"
  rm -rf "$target_dir"
  mkdir -p "$target_dir"
  write_push_payload "$ws_dir" "$branch" "$target_dir/event.json" "$slug"
  echo "=== [$ENGINE/$target] submitting $workflow ($event $git_ref) ==="
  local submit_args=(--server "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" submit
    -W "$ws_dir/$workflow" --workspace-root "$ws_dir"
    --repository "$slug" --git-ref "$git_ref" --event "$event" --payload "$target_dir/event.json")
  if [ -n "${selected:-}" ]; then
    submit_args+=(--selected-jobs "$selected")
    echo "    selected jobs: $selected"
  fi
  local submit
  if ! submit="$("$CLIENT_BIN" "${submit_args[@]}" 2>&1)"; then
    printf '%s\n' "$submit" | tee "$target_dir/submit.txt"
    fail "[$target] workflow submission failed"
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$submit" | tee "$target_dir/submit.txt"
  local run_id
  run_id="$(printf '%s\n' "$submit" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["run_id"])')"
  printf '%s\n' "$run_id" >"$target_dir/run-id.txt"
  local t0 t1 final_status
  t0="$(date +%s%3N)"
  final_status="$(wait_run "$target" "$run_id")"
  t1="$(date +%s%3N)"
  run_snapshot "$run_id" "$target_dir/run.json"
  printf '%s\n' "$final_status" >"$target_dir/status.txt"
  echo "=== [$ENGINE/$target] final status: $final_status (wall: $((t1-t0))ms) ==="
  # Timing record: driver wall clock + server-observed timestamps.
  python3 - "$target_dir" "$run_id" "$final_status" "$((t1-t0))" "$ENGINE" "$selected" <<'PY' || true
import json, sys, pathlib
d, run_id, status, wall_ms, engine, selected = sys.argv[1:]
p = pathlib.Path(d) / "timing.json"
r = json.loads((pathlib.Path(d) / "run.json").read_text())
jobs = r.get("jobs", {})
print(json.dumps({
    "engine": engine, "run_id": run_id, "status": status,
    "wall_ms": int(wall_ms), "selected": selected or None,
    "created_at": r.get("created_at"), "started_at": r.get("started_at"),
    "completed_at": r.get("completed_at"),
    "run_status": r.get("status"),
    "job_statuses": {k: v for k, v in jobs.items() if isinstance(v, str)},
}, indent=2))
json.dump({
    "engine": engine, "run_id": run_id, "status": status,
    "wall_ms": int(wall_ms), "selected": selected or None,
    "created_at": r.get("created_at"), "started_at": r.get("started_at"),
    "completed_at": r.get("completed_at"),
    "run_status": r.get("status"),
    "job_statuses": {k: v for k, v in jobs.items() if isinstance(v, str)},
}, open(p, "w"), indent=2)
PY
  case "$final_status" in
    success|skipped) ;;
    *) FAILED_TARGETS="${FAILED_TARGETS}${target}=${final_status}\n" ;;
  esac
}

main() {
  local repo="${1:-all}"
  local target_list
  if [ -n "${CONFORMANCE_TARGETS:-}" ]; then
    target_list="$CONFORMANCE_TARGETS"
  elif [ "$repo" = "all" ]; then
    target_list="$(all_targets)"
  else
    target_list="$(repo_targets "$repo")" || fail "unknown repository: $repo"
  fi
  [ -x "$SERVER_BIN" ] || fail "missing server binary: $SERVER_BIN"
  [ -x "$CLIENT_BIN" ] || fail "missing client binary: $CLIENT_BIN"
  [ -x "$GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE/preloop-runner" ] || fail "missing guest runner: $GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE/preloop-runner"
  start_server
  for target in $target_list; do
    run_target "$target"
  done
  if [ -n "$FAILED_TARGETS" ]; then
    printf 'Campaign failures:\n%b' "$FAILED_TARGETS" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  echo "Campaign complete. Results: $OUTPUT_ROOT"
}

run_status() {
  curl -fsS --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN}" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/runs/$1" 2>/dev/null \
    | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(r.get("status", "unknown"))' \
    || echo unknown
}

run_snapshot() {
  local run_id="$1" output="$2"
  curl -fsS --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PRELOOP_SYSTEM_TOKEN}" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/runs/$run_id" >"$output" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' '{}' >"$output"
}

write_push_payload() {
  local workspace="$1" branch="$2" output="$3" slug="$4"
  python3 - "$workspace" "$branch" "$slug" >"$output" <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess
import sys

workspace, branch, slug = sys.argv[1:]

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", workspace, *args], text=True
    ).splitlines()

head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")[0]
try:
    before = git("rev-parse", "HEAD^")[0]
except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
    before = "0" * 40
paths = git("ls-files")

print(json.dumps({
    "before": before,
    "after": head,
    "ref": f"refs/heads/{branch}",
    "paths": paths,
    "commits": [{"modified": paths, "added": [], "removed": []}],
    "repository": {"full_name": slug, "default_branch": branch},
    "pull_request": {
        "number": 1,
        "base": {"ref": branch, "sha": before},
        "head": {"ref": branch, "sha": head},
    },
}, separators=(",", ":")))
PY
}

wait_run() {
  local target="$1" run_id="$2" deadline status
  deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + TIMEOUT_SECONDS ))
  while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" ]; do
    if ! kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "[$target] preloop server exited; cannot poll run $run_id" >&2
      printf '%s\n' server-crashed
      return 0
    fi
    status="$(run_status "$run_id")"
    case "$status" in
      success|failure|cancelled|skipped) printf '%s\n' "$status"; return 0 ;;
    esac
    sleep "$POLL_SECONDS"
  done
  printf '%s\n' timeout
}

run_target() {
  local target="$1"
  local cfg slug url branch workflow event git_ref selected
  cfg="$(target_cfg "$target")" || fail "unknown target: $target"
  IFS='|' read -r base selected <<<"$cfg"
  read -r slug url branch workflow event git_ref <<<"$base"
  # The payload and submission need the full `owner/repo` name, not the
  # workspace slug: `github.repository` gates compare against the full name.
  local full
  full="${url#https://github.com/}"
  full="${full%.git}"
  clone_repo "$slug" "$url" "$branch"
  local ws_dir="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/$slug"
  [ -f "$ws_dir/$workflow" ] || fail "$target workflow is missing after checkout: $ws_dir/$workflow"
  local target_dir="$OUTPUT_ROOT/$target"
  rm -rf "$target_dir"
  mkdir -p "$target_dir"
  write_push_payload "$ws_dir" "$branch" "$target_dir/event.json" "$full"
  echo "=== [$ENGINE/$target] submitting $workflow ($event $git_ref) ==="
  local submit_args=(--server "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" submit
    -W "$ws_dir/$workflow" --workspace-root "$ws_dir"
    --repository "$full" --git-ref "$git_ref" --event "$event" --payload "$target_dir/event.json")
  if [ -n "${selected:-}" ]; then
    submit_args+=(--selected-jobs "$selected")
    echo "    selected jobs: $selected"
  fi
  local submit
  if ! submit="$("$CLIENT_BIN" "${submit_args[@]}" 2>&1)"; then
    printf '%s\n' "$submit" | tee "$target_dir/submit.txt"
    fail "[$target] workflow submission failed"
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$submit" | tee "$target_dir/submit.txt"
  local run_id
  run_id="$(printf '%s\n' "$submit" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["run_id"])')"
  printf '%s\n' "$run_id" >"$target_dir/run-id.txt"
  local t0 t1 final_status
  t0="$(date +%s%3N)"
  final_status="$(wait_run "$target" "$run_id")"
  t1="$(date +%s%3N)"
  run_snapshot "$run_id" "$target_dir/run.json"
  printf '%s\n' "$final_status" >"$target_dir/status.txt"
  echo "=== [$ENGINE/$target] final status: $final_status (wall: $((t1-t0))ms) ==="
  # Timing record: driver wall clock + server-observed timestamps.
  python3 - "$target_dir" "$run_id" "$final_status" "$((t1-t0))" "$ENGINE" "$selected" <<'PY' || true
import json, sys, pathlib
d, run_id, status, wall_ms, engine, selected = sys.argv[1:]
p = pathlib.Path(d) / "timing.json"
r = json.loads((pathlib.Path(d) / "run.json").read_text())
jobs = r.get("jobs", {})
print(json.dumps({
    "engine": engine, "run_id": run_id, "status": status,
    "wall_ms": int(wall_ms), "selected": selected or None,
    "created_at": r.get("created_at"), "started_at": r.get("started_at"),
    "completed_at": r.get("completed_at"),
    "run_status": r.get("status"),
    "job_statuses": {k: v for k, v in jobs.items() if isinstance(v, str)},
}, indent=2))
json.dump({
    "engine": engine, "run_id": run_id, "status": status,
    "wall_ms": int(wall_ms), "selected": selected or None,
    "created_at": r.get("created_at"), "started_at": r.get("started_at"),
    "completed_at": r.get("completed_at"),
    "run_status": r.get("status"),
    "job_statuses": {k: v for k, v in jobs.items() if isinstance(v, str)},
}, open(p, "w"), indent=2)
PY
  case "$final_status" in
    success|skipped) ;;
    *) FAILED_TARGETS="${FAILED_TARGETS}${target}=${final_status}\n" ;;
  esac
}

main() {
  local repo="${1:-all}"
  local target_list
  if [ -n "${CONFORMANCE_TARGETS:-}" ]; then
    target_list="$CONFORMANCE_TARGETS"
  elif [ "$repo" = "all" ]; then
    target_list="$(all_targets)"
  else
    target_list="$(repo_targets "$repo")" || fail "unknown repository: $repo"
  fi
  [ -x "$SERVER_BIN" ] || fail "missing server binary: $SERVER_BIN"
  [ -x "$CLIENT_BIN" ] || fail "missing client binary: $CLIENT_BIN"
  [ -x "$GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE/preloop-runner" ] || fail "missing guest runner: $GUEST_RUNNER_BUNDLE/preloop-runner"
  start_server
  for target in $target_list; do
    run_target "$target"
  done
  if [ -n "$FAILED_TARGETS" ]; then
    printf 'Campaign failures:\n%b' "$FAILED_TARGETS" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  echo "Campaign complete. Results: $OUTPUT_ROOT"
}

main "$@"
